answer.rationale: P99 write latency spiked 5x in primary region coinciding with recent release and peak settlement load. Memory_b2 demonstrates regional failover restored latency within minutes during similar degradation. Memory_b1 shows rollback can clear errors but introduces release cycle delay we cannot afford during peak write window. Failover shifts traffic to proven stable region, preserves writes in flight, and allows parallel investigation of the release without customer impact. If failover succeeds, rollback becomes optional; if it fails, rollback remains available. Circuit breaker and read routing don't address write path latency. Capacity addition has lead time we lack.
